annotation.title_clean: Civil liability for damage caused by a robot when performing a medical procedure
annotation.title_en: Civil liability for damage caused by a robot when performing a medical procedure
annotation.venue: Zbornik radova Pravnog fakulteta u Nišu
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: Review article examining civil liability for damage caused by medical/surgical robots under Croatian law, comparing fault-based and strict liability models in light of robot autonomy levels, and arguing for special legislation on medical robot liability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four autonomy levels: direct control, shared control, supervised autonomy, complete autonomy
Fault-based liability burdens patients with proving guilt and causation
Strict liability for dangerous objects/activities increasingly favoured in medicine
Croatian legal system needs legislative intervention for medical robots
Recommendations from international documents should guide drafting
